summary.text: Bonnie Ham is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Grafton 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Jerry Stringham.
A former state representative, she has worked as an auctioneer and antique dealer and has owned a diner.

paragraphs.text: Bonnie Ham earned an M.B.A. from Plymouth State University.
Her career experience includes working as an auctioneer, as an antique dealer, and owning a diner.

Ham won the general election for Grafton 5 in the New Hampshire House in 2016, defeating A.J. Barry, and in the 2017 legislative session she served on the Criminal Justice and Public Safety committee.
Democrat Jerry Stringham defeated her in the 2018 general election, and she won the seat back from him in November 2020.
In 2021-2022 she was assigned to the Commerce and Consumer Affairs Committee.
In November 2022 Stringham defeated her in Grafton 3, and he defeated Republican Paul Schirduan there in 2024, a year in which Schirduan had beaten Ham in the Republican primary.
Ham defeated Schirduan in the Republican primary for Grafton 3 on September 8, 2026.
